definitions.primary: mean object/video micro-F1, with every object/video equally weighted
definitions.top1: fraction of annotated raw frames whose highest-score state belongs to the human label set
definitions.macro_state_f1: mean F1 over GT-present states within each unit; extra states penalize micro-F1
definitions.segments: same-label maximum-cardinality one-to-one interval matching; unknown frames split intervals
definitions.timing: mean endpoint error for matched segments at IoU 0.5 only; inspect with segment recall
definitions.sampling: one prediction every two seconds expanded onto raw frames; frames are correlated
definitions.state_count: number of distinct labels predicted on known annotation frames; candidate inventory is fixed at 77
